d:
Audi is stepping into the full-size luxury SUV segment with the new Q9, its flagship SUV that rivals the Mercedes-Benz GLS and BMW X7. With imposing dimensions, a luxurious cabin, advanced lighting technology and powerful V6 engines, can it reclaim its place among Bollywood's favourite SUVs? Gavin D'Souza drives the new Audi Q9 in Utah, USA, ahead of its expected India launch in 2027.
Editor: Sanil Sawardekar
